entry.title: test: align test doubles and UI state with committed Anki sync code
entry.content:
test: align test doubles and UI state with committed Anki sync code

Land the source and fixture changes already-committed Anki code requires
so a clean checkout typechecks and passes vitest:

- state: add deckScopeKind to AnkiUiState (written by AnkiSyncService)
- dom: add Anki section elements to DomMap (required by committed
  anki-view and its committed test)
- backup: canonicalize Anki snapshot keys with canonicalWord
- worker protocol: reject whitespace-only aniStatuses keys
- anki-connect: clearer api-key/connection error messages
- entry-view: mark Anki-sourced decision badges
- fixtures: protocolVersion 3, previewAnkiMatch on fake workers,
  FakeController anki methods, anki DOM seeds, backup v2 e2e assertion

Excludes the Anki UI wiring (controls/renderer/index.html/styles),
controller anki hunks, and their tests; those stay dirty for scoped
follow-up commits.

entry.title: fix(anki): preserve root cause and coverage on failed apply
entry.content:
fix(anki): preserve root cause and coverage on failed apply

Guard applySync error reporting so a publish failure cannot mask the
original apply rejection (reporting failure attached as cause), and run
the coverage refresh even when the post-apply query refresh fails.
